outlook_text: For the next few days, showers and cloudy conditions are expected over the ASEAN region. The hotspot and smoke haze situation is likely to remain subdued. Isolated hotspots and localised smoke plumes may still develop in areas facing drier conditions. Over the northern ASEAN region, the prevailing winds are expected to blow from the northeast to east while the prevailing winds over the southern ASEAN region are forecast to be light and variable in direction.
